text: every 2 days send me one of the blender tutorials i saved
note: Founder's own example: an interval cadence, not named days.

text: send me workouts randomly
note: Founder's own example: 'randomly' with nothing else is 3 per week (section 1). Section 11 reads 'random' with no frequency word as random picks, so an ask with order random is also accepted.

text: pasta recipe rn pls
note: 'rn' at 21:40 is an answer now; quiet hours never block an answer to a message.

text: anything quick i could make for dinner tonight?
note: A time word that only describes the need stays an ask, not a once rule.

text: keep the meal prep stuff handy for when i need it
note: 'When I need it' is on_request, never a schedule.

text: in 20 min send me a stretching routine
note: Relative time: in_minutes, code works out the clock time.

text: remind me in 2 hrs to take the laundry out
note: A plain reminder in the person's own words: source note, once in 120 minutes.

text: send me a dinner idea at 6
note: 'at 6' at 14:07 means 18:00 today.

text: first thing tmrw send me a workout
note: 'First thing tomorrow' is tomorrow morning (08:00), dated from the local date.

text: next tuesday at noon send me a lunch idea and put it on my calendar
note: Two things at once: a dated once rule plus a calendar action.

text: on dec 3rd at 7pm send me a cocktail recipe
note: Named date next month.

text: evry weekday at 7:30 send me a morning strech
note: Weekdays, with typos.

text: send me my to-do list sat and sun mornings
note: Weekend schedule of the to-do list; 'mornings' is 08:00.

text: push the workout back half an hour
note: Relative change of a rule's time: 08:00 plus 30 minutes, days kept.

text: every day except wednesdays a workout at 6am
note: Days with an exception; 06:00 is the person's explicit time even inside default quiet hours.

text: send me a recipe twice a day, at 8am and 8pm
note: Several times a day in one rule (times).

text: 3x a day pls, morning noon and evening, quick ab workouts
note: Three times a day from named parts of the day, using the default clock times.

text: every other day at 7 a guitar lesson from my youtube
note: 'Every other day' is every_days 2, not alternating weekdays; 'at 7' am or pm both accepted.

text: every 10 days remind me to water the cactus
note: Interval reminder in the person's own words.

text: every other friday a new cocktail at 5pm
note: Every N weeks on a named day.

text: every 3 weeks send me a hike idea
note: Every 3 weeks with no day; every_days 21 is the same cadence.

text: on the 1st and 15th send me a room decor idea
note: Monthly on two dates.

text: last day of every month send me what i saved that month
note: Last day of the month (-1) with the recent source, no search.

text: first monday of each month send me a project idea
note: Nth weekday of a month: month_weeks [1] with days MON (section 11).

text: surprise me with a recipe some time this week
note: One random moment in the rest of this week.

text: a few times a wk at random send me a drawing prompt from my saves
note: 'A few times a week at random': random, per week, count 3 ('a few' is 3, section 11).

text: random workout once a day sometime between 7 and 10am
note: Daily at a random minute inside a window; schedule+window is the same thing.

text: every evening some time between 6 and 8 send a dinner idea
note: Window in place of times.

text: starting monday, every weekday at 7 a workout
note: Start date: 'starting Monday' from Thursday 12 Nov is 16 Nov.

text: a christmas cookie recipe every saturday until christmas
note: End date from a named holiday.

text: send me a stretch every morning at 8, just 5 times
note: Number of sends.

text: every sunday til the end of the semester send me a study tip
note: Unknown end date: clarify keeps the half-built Sunday rule and asks when the semester ends (section 11).

text: send me the workout one now
note: Run a saved rule on demand.

text: skip the next one
note: Skip the next send of the rule that just sent.

text: pause the workouts till monday
note: Pause one rule until a date: pause.until (section 11); Monday as resume day or Sunday as last paused day.

text: dont text me this weekend
note: Do-not-disturb for a period: snooze (until is left free; its format is not pinned).

text: every sunday send me something new close to my blender saves, not stuff i already have
note: Weekly rule with related picks from outside the library.

text: pls no messages before 10am
note: Quiet hours end only; start keeps its default. Times are 'HH:MM' (section 11 blocks).

text: im in LA for the week
note: Travel: time zone change. 'For the week' has no clear end date, so set_timezone.until is left free.

text: move the workout to 6:30
note: Change a rule's time, days kept.

text: make the pasta one every 2 days instead
note: Change weekly to interval, time kept.

text: make it 8pm instead
note: Edit the rule waiting for YES.

text: whenever i save a new recipe send me the ingredients
note: 'When I save something new' is new_items, not on_request.

text: email me these tonight at 8
note: Act on the last answer later: act_on_last with actions and a once when (section 11).

text: every weekday at 8 send me a workout and email it to me too
note: Two things at once: a schedule and a second output.

text: 2nd tuesday of every month remind me to pay the electric bill
note: Nth weekday of a month, as a note reminder.

text: uhh dec 18 i think
note: Answer to a clarify question completes the half-built rule: until 18 Dec, Sunday kept.

text: every 3 months remind me to swap my toothbrush
note: Every N months; the day is left free.

text: every year on march 3rd remind me to renew my car registration
note: Yearly: every_months 12 with month_days and start (the next 3 March is in 2027).

text: every 2 hrs between 9 and 5 send me a posture stretch
note: Every N hours inside a window; the daily send limit still applies.

text: weekdays at 7am a workout but not on the 26th, its thanksgiving
note: Except dates on a weekday schedule.

text: every sunday 6pm new york time send me a meal plan, even when im traveling
note: A rule pinned to one zone (when.tz), even though it is their home zone.

text: hold off on the pasta one until december
note: Pause until a date; the only rule, so rule_number is free.

text: skip the next 2 workouts
note: Skip by count.

text: no workout on the 20th pls
note: Skip by date (Fri 20 Nov).

text: send me fridays pasta now, cooking it tonight instead
note: Run now and skip the next send.

text: im in denver till the 22nd
note: A time zone with an end date; code switches back.

text: remind me to study every night until my exams are over
note: Unknown end date: clarify keeps the half-built note rule and asks when exams end.

text: every weekday at 8 a workout, and weekends at 10
note: Different times on different days: two rules via also (either order).
